relations.relation: partitions metric into discrete practice areas (threat modeling/mitigation, secure design patterns, framework/standard adoption, component protection, supply chain/contribution security) as separately assessable units
locates artifacts or documented actions attesting to each individuated practice subclaim
aggregates located artifacts within a practice area into an adequacy assessment for that area
combines per-area adequacy judgments into a single overall security-practices-and-governance assessment
identifies discrete instances of documented threat modeling (e.g. per-component or per-feature threat model records)
surfaces linkages between an identified threat and a corresponding mitigation or control
surfaces citations or adoption markers of named security frameworks or standards
identifies discrete software components/interfaces to which protective measures apply
surfaces controls governing contribution or dependency intake (e.g. signing, review gating, provenance checks)
delimits a discrete artifact (design doc, pr, commit, or component) as the unit over which a security practice is asserted
attests that a named threat/risk was documented together with a corresponding mitigation or design decision
attests explicit adoption or citation of a recognized security framework or standard
aggregates per-component presence/absence of protective controls into a coverage measure over the unit's components
aggregates presence of contribution-path controls (review gates, provenance, signing) into a governance measure for the unit

metric.name: Security practices and governance
metric.text: Threat modeling and mitigations, secure design patterns, adoption of security frameworks/standards, protection of software components, and supply chain/contribution security.
